national_news.title: Digital self-enumeration for Census 2027 begins in Ladakh today
bullets: The Self-Enumeration is scheduled from August 17 to 31 in the Union Territory of Ladakh.
Ladakh would become the first Union Territory in the country to complete the Census 2027 exercise.
Around 637 Enumeration Blocks (EBs) would be created for the purpose of Census 2027.

national_news.title: NTA Announces Re-Test for Three UGC-NET June 2026 Papers
bullets: NTA announced re-test for three UGC-NET papers: English, Commerce, and Sociology due to errors.
The re-test dates are: English (9th September, 9 am - 12 noon), Commerce (9th September, 3 pm - 6 pm), and Sociology (10th September, 9 am - 12 noon).
UGC-NET is a national-level eligibility test for assistant professor and junior research fellowship.

national_news.title: IMD issues red alert for very heavy rainfall in Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal
bullets: IMD issued a red colour warning for very heavy rainfall to extremely heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha.
Orange alert for very heavy rainfall has been issued for Chhattisgarh, East Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
Heavy rainfall is expected over several states including Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, and others.

national_news.title: Annual pilgrimage to Himalayan shrine of Budha Amarnath begins in Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: The 12-day-long annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra commences amid tight security arrangements.
The Yatra will continue until August 28 and will culminate on Raksha Bandhan.
Authorities have enforced strict multi-tier security and surveillance across Rajouri, Poonch, and transit routes.

national_news.title: India to host 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: India will host the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi.
The meeting will be preceded by the BRICS Senior Officers' Meeting of the Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development.
The event will be held under the theme of India's BRICS Chairship 2026 – Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.

national_news.title: MoS Dr Jitendra Singh to Confer National Anubhav Awards 2026 in New Delhi
bullets: Dr Jitendra Singh will confer the National Anubhav Awards, 2026, in New Delhi.
The event will feature the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra and Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
A Bank Exhibition will be organised, showcasing products and services designed for retiring employees by 17 Pension Disbursing Banks.

national_news.title: Ukraine, Russia exchange missile and drone strikes claiming 11 lives on both sides
bullets: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.
At least 11 people were killed on both sides, with six people killed in Ukraine and five in Russia's southwestern Rostov region.
The strikes damaged several homes, a railway station, and sparked a forest fire.

national_news.title: Indonesia Declares 14-Day Emergency Response Period After 7.7-Magnitude Earthquake
bullets: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Flores in Indonesia, resulting in 51 deaths and 113 injuries.
The Indonesian government declared a 14-day emergency response period to facilitate disaster response, evacuations, relief distribution, and recovery efforts.
The emergency response period will remain in effect till 28th of this month, as per the decree issued by East Nusa Tenggara Governor Melki Laka Lena.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships to Begin in New Delhi
bullets: Indian shuttlers will begin their campaign at the BWF Badminton World Championships today at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi.
PV Sindhu will face Sophia Noble of Ireland in the Women's singles, while Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand will face Paula Lopez and Lucia Rodriguez of Spain in the women's doubles.
Ayush Shetty will face World number one and defending champion Shi Yu Qi of China in the Men's singles.

national_news.title: India Draw 2-2 With China in FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India began their campaign with a thrilling 2-2 draw against China in a group-stage match at Amstelveen in the Netherlands.
Navneet gave India an early lead in the eighth minute, but China equalised through Zhang Ying’s penalty stroke in the 15th minute.
Deepika restored India’s lead in the 25th minute with a penalty-corner goal.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen wins Esports World Cup chess title for second consecutive year
bullets: Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup title for the second year in a row by defeating Denis Lazavik 2-0 in Paris, France.
He remained undefeated throughout the entire tournament, representing Team Liquid.
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured third place after defeating Alireza Firouzja 4-1 in a chaotic bronze-medal match.

national_news.title: DRI uncovers large-scale illegal use of SAFTA agreement in areca imports
bullets: DRI investigation reveals defrauding exchequer of over Rs. 2,500 crore.
Rs. 75 lakh cash and 160 MT areca nuts were seized.
Nine people were arrested for mis-declaring country of origin as Bangladesh.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Illegal Areca Nut Import Network Exploiting SAFTA Duty Exemption
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) busted an illegal areca nut import network.
The network was exploiting the SAFTA duty exemption, leading to a potential revenue loss of Rs 2,500 crore.
Nine people were arrested in connection with the case.

national_news.title: Amrit Udyan opens for public visit for summer annuals edition 2026
bullets: Amrit Udyan in Rashtrapati Bhavan has opened for public visit for the Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition, 2026.
It will remain open till September 15 this year.
President Droupadi Murmu had graced the opening of Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition on Thursday.

bihar_news.title: CM Directs Kalash Yatra and Improves Air Connectivity in Bihar
bullets: CM directed Kalash Yatra from 18-20 August at the Panchayat level.
Improved air connectivity in Bihar will boost tourism, trade, industry, investment, employment, and economic activities.
This move is expected to give a new pace to the state's economy.
